title: No capability-gated composition: packs persisted but never injected stages/agents; media support would fork the pipeline
body: BI-0213: effective stage order + roster from enabled packs; non-pack run byte-identical.

rcca.root_cause: Capability packs were a profile only; there was no mechanism to weave optional stages/agents into the fixed 0..13b order, and the only composition was skip/removal.
rcca.corrective: core/pipeline_composition.py (pure anchor-insert + roster append; identity when no pack); pack schema extended (stages/agents/validators); wired pre-DAGExecutor in both load paths.
rcca.preventive: Non-pack runs return the base object unchanged (byte-identical guard test); unknown anchor is fail-closed (no removal of required stages); reuses DAG skip, not a 4th enable path.
